outcome: spontaneous reset after allocation loop; user confirms no manual restart
conclusion: CMA allocations completed after INIT. The run reset before the next secure command result was recorded; UART alone does not prove the exact reset point or watchdog cause.
limitations: DMA-heap allocation does not exercise DMA coherent virtual mapping.
The 8 KiB baseline is not the exact FPC bounce allocation size: 64-byte request + 64-byte response + 4096-byte auxiliary yields a 12288-byte pool with the current kernel sizing.
Sensor command requests and responses are both 64 bytes, so the suspected general bounce response alignment issue does not affect these INIT/DEEP_SLEEP exchanges.
